answer: Let wander be the disposable head. gale is the single tenure ledger binding key, endpoint and first judged output, so duplicates collide. Weight grows as tenure squared, but one renewal per epoch is allowed only after one more attested epoch than every live twin and burns nadir equal to that lead; the kth wander needs k disjoint chains and about k^2 nadir, serial, not lendable. It breaks if gale dedups weakly, epochs are backdated, or nadir transfers.
